card.title: The Detail That Makes It Official
card.instruction: Choose one tiny procedural detail—wording, order, timing, seating, or a mark—and treat it as the only source of legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This marriage certificate has the dot above the wrong letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twenty years together. But until that dot moves, this doesn't certify a marriage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then move it. Our anniversary party starts at seven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. But we'll need a wedding cake. This dot makes tonight our first day.

mechanism: A makes one dot determine whether the certificate legitimizes twenty years and treats its correction as the actual start of marriage.
confusable: Unlike general standards expertise, the single tiny mark alone decides legitimacy regardless of all lived evidence.
comparison: The certificate alternative converts an anniversary into a first wedding day; the resignation alternative lets page orientation determine membership and refunds.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
